note: Rows describe route ARCHETYPES and the questions to verify, not vendor scorecards. Named products are examples of an archetype; confirm every cell against the provider's own documentation for your account before migrating.

dimensions.label: Model coverage
dimensions.verify: Which model ids do you actually call, and are all of them present? Display names are not model ids.

dimensions.label: Pricing unit
dimensions.verify: Per token, per image, per second, or per call — and is the price per request or per delivered artefact?

dimensions.label: OpenAI compatibility
dimensions.verify: Same path and body for chat, streaming, tools, structured output, vision and images? Which surfaces need an adapter?

dimensions.label: Bring your own keys
dimensions.verify: Can you attach provider keys, or does the platform own the provider relationship?

dimensions.label: Free tier / credits
dimensions.verify: Are free requests rate-limited or model-limited, and what happens when credits run out?

dimensions.label: Rate limits & quotas
dimensions.verify: Requests per minute, tokens per minute, concurrency, and the error shape when you exceed them.

dimensions.label: Async & job model
dimensions.verify: Do generation routes return a task id with a poll URL, and do result URLs expire?

dimensions.label: Retention & regions
dimensions.verify: Log retention, training use, residency and any data processing agreement you need.

dimensions.label: Migration effort
dimensions.verify: base_url swap only, or model-id mapping plus parameter differences plus a new error taxonomy?

archetypes.label: Unified aggregator (OpenRouter-style)
examples: aggregators that expose one API over many providers

traits.unit: typically per token, with per-image models priced per image
traits.compat: OpenAI-shaped chat API, provider-specific passthroughs for some models
traits.free: usually a limited free tier or trial credits
traits.async: mostly synchronous chat; image/video routes vary
traits.retention: set by the platform and the upstream provider

archetypes.label: Per-unit relay route
examples: per-image, per-second and per-token relay endpoints

traits.coverage: curated set of image, video and text models
traits.unit: flat per image / per second / per token
traits.compat: OpenAI-compatible paths with an async task model for generation
traits.limits: documented per-route limits and a task TTL
traits.async: task id + poll URL, expiring result URLs
traits.migration: base_url swap plus model-id mapping plus poll-loop change

traits.unit: provider units plus your infrastructure cost
